description: This file defines the EBSException class, which represents errors related to interactions with the Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the generic AwsException class.

classes.name: EBSException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Amazon EBS related errors, extending the general AWS exception handling class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherits the constructor from AwsException, used for initializing the exception with relevant error information.
